verdicts.reason: Both use the same cramped leaderboard layout. The subhead is squeezed into a narrow 5-line italic column, "SOLSTICE PRESENTS" has dropped below the headline, and the RSVP button competes with three equally loud pills, with tiny fine print jammed together at the right edge. A appears to lose the sun mark from the logo, and the missing-asset placeholder is crammed against the wordmark. B keeps the logo intact, but the placeholder butts right up against the wordmark.
